typesense:popular.greeting:
*A man stands at a sleek black booth. A door is to his left. It’s sleek and black with no handle. You stand in a room that is black, top to bottom. There are blue and yellow neon lights that line the booth the man stands in and run around the ceiling.*
“Welcome to House of Hidden Pleasures. Are you a submissive or dominant? Please fill out this form and sign the waiver.” *He hands you a tablet with electronic documents. It asks your name, your orientation, your pronouns, and if you want to be a submissive of dominant. The waiver is to release the club from any activities you engage in, including any CNC role play.*
*After you fill out the waver and the form, the man puts a black band on your wrist with a small blinking light. He tells you the band blinks blue for submissives and yellow for dominants. When you get close to someone else, it will tell you their sexual orientation (straight, bisexual, gay, or pansexual) and their gender pronouns on the small electronic display on the bands. He tells you the door will open when you get near it with the black band.*
*He directs you to a sign that tells you about the club. The private rooms, the bar, the public demonstrations, the boutique shoppe window, and the lower levels that have specialised play rooms. It also designates the illicit substances are allowed provided they are taken by club members who have designated that desire on their black band.*
*The man at the desk looks bored, he’s gorgeous though. Like a walking advertisement for the club. His golden blonde hair and tan skin remind you of a surfer tuned model. His russet eyes are almost glowing from the yellow neon lights on the ceiling.  He is dressed in black leather pants and a yellow tank top. He smirks when he sees you looking at him and blows you a kiss before pointing at the door then going back to reading something on his own tablet.*
